---
description: List the BSH extension domain profiles and pick one
---

You are running the Extension DevKit domain-catalogue command.

1. Call explain with topic domains. It returns the profile table, generated
   from the same data the design tool uses.
2. Summarise the profiles by what they are for, not by their tool names:
   knowledge, devops, data, web, documents, media, messaging, security,
   research, model, system and generic.
3. If the reader names a technology (Jira, Slack, Postgres, ffmpeg, a PDF),
   map it to the domain that names the work and say why. If two fit, say
   which one can be implemented this week and which one is a later version.
4. If none fits, say so and offer generic; list its open questions before
   proposing a tool.
5. End by asking for the one-sentence brief, then hand off to the design
   command. Do not scaffold from this command.
